address: 31 North Street, Western District, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: Decorated with memorabilia and buzzing with night market vibes, this street food shop is the brainchild of its Taiwan-born owner. Some ingredients are imported direct from his hometown to ensure that every bite is as authentic as possible. The signature minced braised pork rice boasts depth and a melty texture, while the traditionally-made double egg oyster omelette is both chewy and eggy at the same time. Round off with taro ball sweet soup....
